selected_work: R117/R118 native DX11 transport handoff sealing: require identity-complete FrameAck acknowledgements and expose an immutable exact Published lifetime/slot/frame shared-eye publication snapshot without enabling native draw or host routing.
summary: R117 removes the frameId-only IFrameConsumer acknowledgement boundary and compile-locks IFrameConsumer::acknowledge(const FrameAck&) so producer/consumer PID, run generation, transport generation, slot and frame identity remain intact. R118 adds NativeSharedEyePublication plus snapshot_published_frame/validate_publication_snapshot, allowing handoff only for an exact currently Published frame after producer EVENT completion and rejecting stale snapshots after ACK retirement, lifetime invalidation, generation replacement or hard retirement. Hosted WARP transport coverage and the mandatory source verifier seal the contract; native game draw and OpenXR host routing remain dormant.

risk_review.reason: The task changes dormant backend-neutral/DX11 transport contracts and hosted verification only. It does not activate native draw ownership, alter the D3D9/DX9Ex render policy, route OpenXR host consumption, or claim Quest3/VDXR graphics correctness. Exact identity and publication-lifetime checks reduce stale-handoff risk but remain runtime-untested.
